title: Review of c51's Toner-Tu eaters negative: on fresh seeds 5 and 6 and at world dt/2 the crescents of t~120 become fronts that align into box-spanning bands (3-4 components at t=3000, 0 persistent tracks, 0 persistent splits), while the v0=0 twin gives 168 splitting spots (67 persistent splits, generation 3)
summary: Re-ran the author's world.py with labkit as in runs.sh (150 frames x 80 steps, T=3000): v0 0.25 seeds 5 and 6, the v0=0 twin seed 5, and v0 0.25 at world dt 0.125 (160 steps per frame) seed 5. Motile: final components 3/4, longest track 17/8 frames, 0 persistent tracks, 0 persistent splits, 431/423 nucleations; dt/2: 3 components, longest 28 frames, 0 persistent splits. v0=0 twin: 168 components, 156 persistent tracks, 67 persistent splits, generation 3. pack/seed5/sheet.png shows crescents at t=120, merging fronts by t=400 and aligned travelling bands from t~1500.

observations.finding: pack/seed5/sheet.png t=120: discrete crescents; t=400-1000: fronts merge; t=1560-3000: box-spanning aligned bands; FACTS seed 5/6: 0 persistent tracks, 0 persistent splits. pack_v0/FACTS.md: 67 persistent splits, generation 3, 156 persistent tracks (the matched twin keeps Gray-Scott splitting spots).

pass: 4 components, 0 persistent splits, longest track 8 frames
